brief: A personal mark for Zaki Amin Ahmad, a builder who ships real data and trading systems, aimed at recruiters for a Summer 2027 data or full-stack co-op. It replaces Masthead ZA.
criteria: Success: recognisable at 16 px, explainable in one sentence, distinct from Zendesk, Zorin, ZenHub, npm and Vercel, works in one colour.

concepts.name: One line
concepts.idea: Z and A drawn as one unbroken stroke; the wordmark carries it straight into KI.
rationale: Every diagonal at 60°, so the Z's diagonal and the A's left leg run parallel
A separate 16 px cut keeps the favicon on whole pixels
Sulfur on Night tile, Ink or Chalk everywhere else

recommendation: One line, now live as the favicon, home-screen icon and nav mark on zakiamin.com.
next_steps: Update the GitHub and LinkedIn avatars if they should carry the mark
Run a trademark search before any commercial use
